name: Filtration Width
definition: For a nested sequence of nonempty binary classes $C_0\subseteq\cdots\subseteq C_m$ on one coordinate set, minimize the ordering width of $C_m$ over orders in which every $C_j$ is a prefix.
parameters: A finite nested filtration of nonempty classes on a common displayed coordinate set; repeated stages are allowed.
normalization: $w(C_0)=\sigma(C_0)$. Each stage is prescribed only as a set, so its internal order remains optimized subject to all earlier stages.
comments: This is an invariant of a filtered class rather than of its terminal class alone.
